microtheory.name: medicine_general
microtheory.definition: Medicine — diagnosis, treatment, prevention of disease + injury. Hippocrates, Galen, Vesalius, Pasteur, Koch, Fleming, Salk. Branches: internal, surgery, pediatrics, obstetrics, psychiatry, public health. Evidence-based medicine, clinical reasoning, patient autonomy. Substrate analogue: applied science of maintaining biological-system function under disease/damage.

concepts.name: disease
concepts.definition: Pathological condition with characteristic signs + symptoms. Etiology, pathogenesis, manifestation. Substrate analogue: substrate's failure-mode pattern.

concepts.name: symptom
concepts.definition: Patient's subjective experience of disease (pain, nausea). Distinguished from sign.

concepts.name: sign_medical
concepts.definition: Objective observation by clinician (rash, murmur). What the doctor finds.

concepts.name: diagnosis
concepts.definition: Identification of disease from symptoms + signs + tests. Differential diagnosis lists possibilities ranked.

concepts.name: prognosis
concepts.definition: Predicted course + outcome of disease. With + without treatment.

concepts.name: etiology
concepts.definition: Cause(s) of disease. Genetic, infectious, traumatic, environmental, idiopathic (unknown).

concepts.name: pathogenesis
concepts.definition: Mechanism by which disease develops + progresses.

concepts.name: hippocratic_tradition
concepts.definition: Hippocrates ~400 BCE. First-do-no-harm. Naturalistic disease causation. Hippocratic Oath.

concepts.name: galen
concepts.definition: Galen ~150 CE. Four humors. Dominated Western medicine ~1500 years until Vesalius corrected anatomy.

concepts.name: germ_theory
concepts.definition: Pasteur + Koch ~1860s. Microorganisms cause disease. Foundation of modern infectious medicine.

concepts.name: antibiotic_age
concepts.definition: Fleming 1928 penicillin. Treats bacterial infections. Resistance now major problem.

concepts.name: vaccination
concepts.definition: Jenner 1796 (smallpox), Pasteur, Salk. Train immune system. Greatest public health intervention.

concepts.name: internal_medicine
concepts.definition: Adult diagnosis + non-surgical treatment. Cardiology, pulmonology, gastroenterology, nephrology, etc.

concepts.name: surgery
concepts.definition: Treatment via operation. General, orthopedic, neuro, cardiac, plastic, transplant.

concepts.name: pediatrics
concepts.definition: Medical care of infants + children + adolescents.

concepts.name: obstetrics_gynecology
concepts.definition: Pregnancy + childbirth + reproductive health.

concepts.name: psychiatry
concepts.definition: Mental disorders. DSM diagnostic categories. Pharmacology + psychotherapy combined.

concepts.name: emergency_medicine
concepts.definition: Acute presentations. Triage, resuscitation, stabilisation.

concepts.name: family_medicine
concepts.definition: Continuity care across lifespan + family. Primary care.

concepts.name: evidence_based_medicine
concepts.definition: Sackett. Clinical decisions integrating best research evidence, clinical expertise, patient values. RCTs + meta-analyses + Cochrane.

concepts.name: randomized_controlled_trial
concepts.definition: RCT. Subjects randomly assigned to treatment vs control. Best design for causal inference.

concepts.name: meta_analysis
concepts.definition: Statistical combination of multiple studies. Quantifies effects across heterogeneous evidence.

concepts.name: number_needed_to_treat
concepts.definition: NNT. Patients needed to treat for one to benefit. Communicates effect size.

concepts.name: sensitivity_specificity
concepts.definition: Test characteristics. Sensitivity = true-positive rate; specificity = true-negative rate. Trade off via threshold.

concepts.name: bayes_theorem_diagnosis
concepts.definition: P(disease|test+) depends on prior (prevalence) + test characteristics. Base-rate neglect common in clinicians.

concepts.name: physical_examination
concepts.definition: Hands-on patient assessment. Inspection, palpation, percussion, auscultation. Increasingly displaced by imaging.

concepts.name: differential_diagnosis
concepts.definition: List of possible diagnoses given presentation. Ranked by likelihood. Drives investigation.

concepts.name: occams_razor_medical
concepts.definition: Prefer single diagnosis explaining all findings. Hickam's dictum opposes: patient can have as many diseases as they please.

concepts.name: rare_disease
concepts.definition: Affecting <1 in 2000. Diagnostic odyssey common. Substrate analogue: substrate's edge-case detection.

concepts.name: pharmacotherapy
concepts.definition: Drug treatment. Pharmacokinetics (what body does to drug) + pharmacodynamics (what drug does to body).

concepts.name: polypharmacy
concepts.definition: Multiple drugs. Common in elderly. Drug-drug interactions increase combinatorially.

concepts.name: placebo_effect
concepts.definition: Improvement from expectation alone. Robust phenomenon. Conditions blinding required for RCT validity.

concepts.name: iatrogenic_harm
concepts.definition: Harm caused by medical care. Hippocratic 'first do no harm' addresses. Major patient-safety focus.

concepts.name: public_health
concepts.definition: Population-level health. Vaccination, sanitation, smoking cessation, fluoridation. Greatest gains historically here.

concepts.name: epidemiology
concepts.definition: Distribution + determinants of disease in populations. Snow's cholera 1854, Doll-Hill smoking, modern COVID surveillance.

concepts.name: social_determinants_health
concepts.definition: Income, education, housing, social support stronger predictors of health than medical care itself.

concepts.name: informed_consent
concepts.definition: Patient autonomy. Voluntary, informed, competent decision. Nuremberg Code foundational.

concepts.name: doctor_patient_relationship
concepts.definition: Trust, communication, shared decision-making. Paternalism → autonomy → partnership.

concepts.name: end_of_life_care
concepts.definition: Palliative + hospice. Quality vs duration of life. Advance directives. Distinct from euthanasia.

rules.name: bayes_governs_diagnosis
rules.head: Jabberwock interprets a positive test result
rules.body: P(disease|test+) depends on disease prevalence + test sensitivity/specificity. Low prevalence + imperfect test → many false positives even with high specificity.

rules.name: evidence_hierarchy_systematic_reviews_top
rules.head: Jabberwock evaluates medical evidence
rules.body: systematic review of RCTs > single RCT > cohort > case-control > case series > expert opinion. Substrate's evidence-quality ordering.

rules.name: first_do_no_harm
rules.head: Jabberwock considers a medical intervention
rules.body: iatrogenic harm vs treatment benefit must be weighed. Hippocratic primum non nocere. Conservative default.

rules.name: informed_consent_requires_understanding
rules.head: Jabberwock obtains consent
rules.body: patient must be informed, competent, voluntary. Information given at patient's level of understanding.

rules.name: social_determinants_dominate_individual_care
rules.head: Jabberwock considers population health
rules.body: income + education + housing + environment outweigh medical care in determining health outcomes. Public health > clinical medicine in aggregate.
